description: Scores an ADR or architecture decision for completeness: decision clarity, alternatives, consequences, and the four cross-cutting dimensions.

scoring.scale: 0 = absent, 1 = partial (mentioned but vague), weight = fully present and concrete

dimensions.name: Decision clarity
dimensions.criterion: The chosen option is stated unambiguously in one sentence. The scope of the decision is bounded — it is clear what is inside vs. outside the decision. Status (Accepted / Proposed / Superseded) is set.
dimensions.gap_signal: The decision section is prose about the problem rather than a declarative statement of the choice; or the status field is missing.

dimensions.name: Alternatives considered
dimensions.criterion: At least two alternatives are named with a one-sentence rationale for why each was not chosen. 'We didn't consider other options' fails. A genuinely obvious single-choice with no real alternatives earns partial credit with an explanation.
dimensions.gap_signal: No alternatives section; or alternatives are listed without rationale for rejection.

dimensions.name: Consequences
dimensions.criterion: Both positive and negative consequences of the decision are named. Positive-only consequences lists signal motivated reasoning and earn partial credit.
dimensions.gap_signal: Only upsides described; negative consequences, limitations, or future complexity are absent.

dimensions.name: Risk coverage
dimensions.criterion: Risks and the conditions under which the decision should be revisited are named. A 'revisit if' clause or 'this breaks down when' note earns full credit.
dimensions.gap_signal: No risk named; no statement of when the decision would need to be reversed or superseded.

dimensions.name: Reversibility and migration
dimensions.criterion: If the decision is hard to reverse (data schema, public contract, naming), the cost of reversal is stated. Easy-to-reverse decisions may state 'low reversal cost' as N/A with full credit.
dimensions.gap_signal: An irreversible or costly-to-reverse decision does not state the reversal cost or migration path.

dimensions.name: Maintainability and ownership
dimensions.criterion: A maintainer or team is named. Long-lived architectural commitments state a review trigger (e.g., 'revisit when performance exceeds X').
dimensions.gap_signal: No owner named; no trigger for revisiting a long-lived commitment.

dimensions.name: ADR format completeness
dimensions.criterion: Standard ADR sections are present: Status, Context, Decision, Consequences, Alternatives. An index entry exists (regenerated by `adr-create`). Superseded ADRs link to their successor.
dimensions.gap_signal: Missing standard sections; or no index entry; or superseded record does not link to successor.
